notes.title: PARSE v1.3 | Gameplay Update!
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay update[/b], but rather a [i]"step by step"[/i] mode of the game.

[h1]Important[/h1]
[list]
[*]System improvement of weapons and items gathering!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/db1034941b615dd1ce71ff62425d6bdc47faac73.png[/img]

[*]With enemies will now drop items with which you can improve your weapons.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/589fbaac667dfc57e04b2d759e34f2478b356989.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/aa8de85c98fb223b9347ca6fa7d52612fd5cb32e.png[/img]

[*]The map will now appear turrets, the damage of which depends on their number.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525612/e2df29390491609f4b722f7f2bd7508730ad22bc.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Less important[/h1]
[list]
[*]The fog of war is now more complex logic.
[*]Fixed a balance between the destruction of the buildings and their restoration.
[*]Superior part of the graphics component.
[*]Increased the chance to spawn of the Agoran 1%.
[/list]

notes.title: PARSE v1.2
notes.content:
We are happy to present you a new update for PARSE!
[h1]StoryLine Mode[/h1]
[b]Afton[/b]
Afton is your commander, who will help you understand the game and will accompany you all your journey.
Afton is a representative of another race and the only living being who agreed to help you.
[url=https://hostingkartinok.com/show-image.php?id=6d7fc4c8913a82400c6ace08f7141afa][img]https://s8.hostingkartinok.com/uploads/images/2017/09/6d7fc4c8913a82400c6ace08f7141afa.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Agoran is new enemy![/h1]
[b]Agoran[/b]
Agoran is now your new enemy, he will choose when to come to the battlefield and when to take active actions.
His attacks will not let you relax. And he ignores the obstacles.
[url=https://hostingkartinok.com/show-image.php?id=f2f1eedb6572ab723029cc3874549bea][img]https://s8.hostingkartinok.com/uploads/images/2017/09/f2f1eedb6572ab723029cc3874549bea.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Other features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Edit the balance of the game.
[*]The number of units at the start is reduced from 500,000 to 200,000.
[*]The ability to reset progress has been added.
[*]Weakened your influence on the number of soldiers in any sector.
[*]Strongly your influence on the number of buildings in any sector.
[*]At the death of a unit in space, you lose 20 times more soldiers.
[*]Increased the chance of appearance of the subject in all sectors.
[/list]

notes.title: StoryLine | Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]StoryLine Mode[/h1]
We will announce something that will be able to expand the understanding of the world of the game and make it more interesting.
The update will tell you more about [b]Afton[/b], referred to in the game.
Release date: [b]Very soon[/b].
